description: Attach a reminder to an event or todo. Required: subject_type ('event'|'todo'), subject_id, trigger_at (ISO) OR offset_minutes (before due/start). action: 'notify' (default) or 'trigger_agent' (+agent_id) so an agent re-runs at T. NOTE: fires on-demand / via the mcp_client bootstrap (no server cron yet).

action.description: notify (default) or trigger_agent to re-run agent_id at that time

offset_minutes.description: Minutes before the due/start time to fire, alternative to trigger_at

subject_type.description: What the reminder is attached to: event or todo

name: set_reminder
